en: The front of the postcard features a color illustration of a boy in traditional hiking or travel attire, carrying a backpack, walking stick, and wearing a checkered cap. He is winking and smiling, with a rolled blanket attached to his backpack. The writing on the front is in German script. The reverse side has handwritten text, a green Deutsches Reich (German Empire) postage stamp, postal marks, and an address. There is also a blue stamp reading 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
